subject.title: feat: add NVIDIA Nemotron Speech ASR and TTS

question: Should an existing NVIDIA chat-model credential automatically opt a user into remote NVIDIA batch ASR, or must NVIDIA speech require explicit audio/TTS configuration?
rationale: This is a user-facing privacy, cost, and upgrade-policy choice; code review cannot infer whether reusing a chat credential authorizes new audio egress.

options.title: Require explicit speech opt-in
options.body: Register NVIDIA speech only when users configure the NVIDIA audio or TTS provider, preserving existing local-audio behavior for chat-only NVIDIA users.

options.title: Accept automatic ASR selection
options.body: Keep automatic selection, but explicitly document the new audio egress and add upgrade and live-endpoint proof that supports this product choice.

recommendation.title: Require explicit speech opt-in
recommendation.body: Register NVIDIA speech only when users configure the NVIDIA audio or TTS provider, preserving existing local-audio behavior for chat-only NVIDIA users.

likelyOwner.reason: A bundled-provider credential-reuse policy requires repository-level product direction.
